title: Compact Hausdorff ultrafilter space with its clopen basis
statement: Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For any set $S$, let $\mathcal U(S)$ be the set of ultrafilters on $S$: maximal proper filters, where a proper filter is a family of subsets containing $S$, not containing $\varnothing$, closed under finite intersections and under passage to supersets. For $A\subseteq S$, put $[A]=\{F\in\mathcal U(S):A\in F\}$. Give $\mathcal U(S)$ the topology generated by all the sets $[A]$. Then $\mathcal U(S)$ is compact and Hausdorff, and the sets $[A]$ form a basis of open and closed subsets.
